::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** July 14th 1887  
**From:** Elderfield Otterbourne  
**Manuscript:** MS Bodleian Library Benson C.5.4  fol 96
:::

Dear [Miss Benson](people/person_1858.qmd)
I have sent up your joint story, for which I thank you much, to have the length of pages calculated. If it goes in, it will stand first before a sad and true [scene in a secularised hospital](other_books/otherbook_316.qmd) at Paris by [Madame de Witt](people/person_423.qmd) so as to shew the fruits of the cult of humanity without its Master. But I am not sure that I can get it in, and I also think that though it is rather long for the purpose, it might for its own sake and that of the idea be longer so that I shall not so much regret if it has to be sacrificed
Yours truly
C M Yonge
